greetings.text: Hullo there! Come in and take your boots off, if you have a mind.
Oh, it's you. I thought it was someone else. There's been a draught at the door.
Hush! Not so loud. Something was at the hedge last night.
Oh, thank goodness. I've been in such a state. Please, please come in.

farewells.text: Right then. I'll stay here and keep things in order.

smalltalk.text: A quiet house, a warm fire and a pie in the pantry: that's all a sensible hobbit wants.
Frodo's busy with something and won't say what. I'm not one to pry.
I'm no use out of doors after dark. I'd rather be inside.
Merry says to keep the house and look as if Frodo were here. I can do that.

black_rider_in_hobbiton.text: A black rider? Hush. I thought I saw one at the hedge. I locked the door twice.

black_riders_asking_for_baggins.text: They were looking for a Baggins. In the dark, with a horrid hissing voice. I got out through the back and ran for my life.
